description: Enrich the task modal and task cards with the core productivity fields that mature to-do apps (Todoist, TickTick, Things) offer: priority levels, tags/labels, subtasks (checklist with progress), recurrence, and a notes field. Depends on FEAT-001's extended schema. Also make due date optional (many tasks have no deadline) while preserving existing overdue/calendar logic for tasks that do have a date.
steps: In index.html task modal (#task-form), add form controls styled consistently with existing .form-group / .form-row patterns: a Priority selector (None/Low/Medium/High) as a segmented button group or select; a Tags input (comma-separated text, e.g. id 'task-tags'); a Recurrence select (None/Daily/Weekly/Monthly, id 'task-recurrence'); a Notes textarea (id 'task-notes'); and a Subtasks section with an add-subtask input + list where each row has a checkbox, editable title, and remove button.

Make the due date optional: remove the `required` attribute from #task-date and handle empty dueDate throughout (tasks with no dueDate should not appear as overdue and should sort after dated tasks). Add a small 'Clear'/no-date affordance.
In app.js handleTaskSubmit, read the new fields (priority, tags parsed/trimmed from comma list, recurrence, notes, subtasks collected from the modal) and persist them via normalizeTask.
In openModal(task), populate all new fields when editing, and reset them cleanly when creating. Manage the dynamic subtask rows (add/remove/toggle) with local modal state or DOM reads on submit.

Update createTaskCard in app.js to surface the new data: a priority badge/flag with color, tag chips, and a subtask progress indicator (e.g. '2/5' with a small progress bar) and a recurrence icon when recurrence != none. Keep the existing color bar, overdue badge, and edit button.

Add CSS in style.css for: priority badges (high=red, medium=orange, low=blue, none=hidden), tag chips, subtask list rows in the modal, subtask progress bar on cards, and the recurrence indicator. Match the glass/dark theme and CSS variables. Ensure the modal remains scrollable on mobile (it already has max-height/overflow rules).
Bump the style.css cache-busting query (?v=) in index.html.
acceptance_criteria: Creating a task with priority High, two tags, a recurrence of Weekly, notes text, and two subtasks persists all of that to localStorage and shows it on the task card (priority badge, tag chips, subtask progress, recurrence icon).
Editing that task repopulates every field correctly in the modal, including subtask checked state.
A task created with no due date saves successfully, does not render an 'Overdue' badge, and appears on the board.
Toggling a subtask checkbox updates the progress indicator after save.
`node --check app.js` exits 0 and no console errors occur during create/edit.
verification: Serve with `python3 -m http.server 8000`; create/edit tasks exercising every new field; confirm card rendering and localStorage contents; confirm no console errors.
Confirm existing features (drag-drop status change, calendar labels, dashboard lists) still work after the modal/card changes.
findings: Added Priority (radio segmented group, name=task-priority), Tags (id task-tags, comma-parsed), Recurrence (select id task-recurrence), Notes (textarea id task-notes), and a dynamic Subtasks section (input id subtask-input + button id add-subtask-btn + #subtask-list rows) to the modal. Subtask rows carry id via data-id and are read back by collectSubtasksFromModal on submit; Enter in the subtask input adds a row. Due date made optional: removed required on #task-date, added a Clear button (id clear-date-btn). New helpers isTaskOverdue() and compareByDueDate() centralize empty-dueDate handling (undated tasks never overdue, sort last); applied in dashboard, board, calendar, and upcoming-deadlines. createTaskCard now renders priority badge (low=blue, medium=orange, high=red, none hidden), tag chips, subtask progress (count + bar), and a recurrence repeat icon. Added escapeHtml() and used it for card title/description/tags to avoid XSS from user text. formatDate returns 'No due date' for empty. Icons refreshed via refreshIcons() (guards missing lucide). CSS added for all new elements matching glass/dark theme; select styling added. Bumped style.css cache-bust to ?v=1.7.0. On create, modal still defaults the due date to now+1h (user can Clear it). Verified: NODE_OPTIONS= node --check app.js exits 0; python3 http.server serves index/app.js/style.css with 200; pure-helper logic unit-checked in node. No automated tests exist (manual/static verification per context.json).
